name: Plaid
description: Financial technology platform that securely connects applications to thousands of banks for retrieving account information, transactions, balances, and more.

evidence.claim: To gain access to the Plaid API, create an account on the Plaid Dashboard. Once you've completed the signup process... we'll provide a live client_id and secret via the Dashboard.
The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP.

notes: Plaid provides self-service sandbox access via the Plaid Dashboard, issuing client_id and secret credentials upon signup. Production access can also be requested through the dashboard.
